name: Human interaction

subjectOf.text: Despite their benefits, smart contracts are subject to significant limitations because human business interactions require a flexibility that is at odds with the merciless mathematical logic of smart contracts.
subjectOf.abstract: Despite the significant benefits of smart contracting for business and society, smart contracts are subject to significant limitations. Human business interactions require a flexibility that is at odds with merciless mathematical logic of smart contracts.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Commerce – A Primer on Why Decentralized Reputation Verification Systems Are Needed (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3405401
scope_conditions: human business interactions rather than fully mechanical exchanges

subjectOf.text: Human business interaction typically requires the possibility that each party may fulfill only a portion of an intended collaboration, a partial performance option that mathematically rigid smart contracts do not accommodate.
subjectOf.abstract: Human business interaction also typically requires the possibility that each party may fulfill only a portion of any intended collaboration.
